title: Variance-based large-coefficient family
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$. Form the family of low-degree subsets on the variance-based Friedgut coordinates of $f$, using its variance-based Friedgut degree as the degree bound, and remove the empty subset.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function from $\{-1,1\}^n$ to $\{-1,1\}$
caveat: The construction of low-degree subsets, Friedgut coordinates and degree, and Boolean-function variance are not supplied.
